admit site vm of f2a9c4e1-0b7d-4c3a-9e2f-5a6b7c8d9e01 as paisans-f2a9 on fake (ubuntu 24.04)

step 1: claim the host
step 2: create /etc/paisans
step 3: record what admit installs

step 4: create user paisans-f2a9
  user: create paisans-f2a9 with a home, whose subordinate ID ranges useradd allocates
  run:
    $ useradd --create-home --shell /bin/bash paisans-f2a9

step 5: skip the mesh until its conf exists

step 6: start paisans-f2a9's manager after the mesh
  user: order user@<uid>.service after wg-quick@psns-f2a9 at boot, so a container that publishes on the mesh address finds it; a manager running now is not restarted, and takes it at its next start. Until the mesh's conf is written, wg-quick@psns-f2a9 is skipped
  provisional: run once the user exists
  write /etc/systemd/system/user@<uid>.service.d/paisans-mesh.conf mode 0644:
    | # Written by paisans site admit for deployment f2a9; paisans site evict
    | # removes it. The user's manager, its Docker daemon and its containers
    | # start after the mesh at boot.
    | [Unit]
    | Wants=wg-quick@psns-f2a9.service
    | After=wg-quick@psns-f2a9.service
  run:
    $ systemctl daemon-reload

step 7: delegate cgroups to users
  delegation: let every user's manager delegate cpu cpuset io memory pids, for compose's limits; written before paisans-f2a9's manager first starts
  write /etc/systemd/system/user@.service.d/delegate.conf mode 0644:
    | # Written by paisans site admit. Shared by every admitted deployment;
    | # paisans site evict removes it with the last of them.
    | [Service]
    | Delegate=cpu cpuset io memory pids
  run:
    $ systemctl daemon-reload

step 8: write the egress table
step 9: install the egress unit
step 10: load the egress table

step 11: enable linger for paisans-f2a9
  linger: run paisans-f2a9's manager, its Docker daemon and its timers without a login, and at boot
  run:
    $ loginctl enable-linger paisans-f2a9

step 12: start paisans-f2a9's manager
  linger: start user@<uid>.service and wait for it, which does nothing to a manager already running
  provisional: run once the user exists
  run:
    $ systemctl start user@<uid>.service

step 13: load br_netfilter
step 14: load br_netfilter at boot
step 15: write paisans-f2a9's daemon.json
step 16: install paisans-f2a9's rootless Docker
step 17: create /srv/paisans
step 18: create /srv/paisans/f2a9
step 19: create /etc/wireguard
step 20: create /usr/local/libexec/paisans
step 21: install the WireGuard helper
step 22: install the helper's sudoers line
step 23: allow 22/tcp
step 24: allow 51820/udp
step 25: allow all inbound on psns-f2a9
step 26: write the admission record
step 27: add the operators' keys
